### I am Daniel Soto

I am an incoming M.S. student at Northwestern University's Engineering and Applied Mathematics (ESAM) program.
I have a dual major in Mathematics (B.S.) and Linguistics (B.A.) from the University of Florida, along with a minor in Statistics.

I have applied my skills in a diverse set of projects. at the University of Florida, I contributed to a project involving Linguistic Indicators of Hoarding Disorder.
At the Summer Internship in Biostatistics and Data Science (SIBDS), I helped analyze risk factors contributing to weapon-carrying behavior, and also assessed the benefits of soluble corn fiber supplements towards aiding bone development in teens.

I am deeply invested in `mathematical modeling` and `computational modeling`: I am eager to find areas in our lives where we can apply modeling to solve complex problems.
I also enjoy `data science`, applying `statistics` and `machine learning` techniques to reveal insights and patterns among many types of data.

I am also dedicated to ensuring clarity and reproducibility in my work, using tools like `Quarto` and `RMarkdown`. This approach ensures that my research is trustworthy and easily followed by others.
